description: Source code for managing email campaigns in ERPNext, including campaign validation, scheduling, sending emails, and status updates.

classes.name: EmailCampaign
classes.description: Class representing an email campaign with validation, scheduling, and status management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the email campaign, including date and lead validation, and checks for duplicate campaigns.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the end date of the campaign based on the start date and campaign schedule.

methods.name: validate_lead
methods.description: Validates that the lead has an email address.

methods.name: validate_email_campaign_already_exists
methods.description: Checks if an email campaign with the same campaign name and recipient already exists.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the campaign status based on current date and campaign dates.
